subsetPolicyRationale: `s.sourcing.curation@1` is this plugin's own self-contained sourcing/curation catalogue document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (create-curated-item, delete-curated-item, change-curated-item-count, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
